_comment: Feathers Minecraft Java (Windows-native) egg. Docker image is the platform marker 'windows/...' — the winproc daemon rejects non-windows eggs, and Linux/Docker nodes reject this one. The install script is PowerShell (the daemon runs it natively, not in a container). REQUIRES a Java runtime (e.g. Temurin JRE 21) installed and on PATH on the Windows node.
name: Minecraft Java (Windows)
author: test@feathers.local
description: Vanilla Minecraft Java server for Windows-native (winproc) nodes. Downloads the official server jar and accepts the EULA during install. Requires a Java runtime on the node's PATH.
_features_comment: Features are intentionally null on Windows: the 'java_version'/'pid_limit'/'eula' features all remedy via Docker (e.g. switching container image), which is meaningless on a winproc node where the image is only a platform marker. Leaving them on hijacks the console with a useless 'Update Docker Image' modal.

installation.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Write-Output 'Resolving Minecraft server download...'
$ver = $env:VANILLA_VERSION
$manifest = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json'
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ver) -or $ver -eq 'latest') { $ver = $manifest.latest.release }
$entry = $manifest.versions | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $ver } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $entry) { Write-Output ('Version ' + $ver + ' not found'); exit 1 }
Write-Output ('Selected Minecraft version: ' + $ver)
$meta = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $entry.url
$url = $meta.downloads.server.url
$jar = $env:SERVER_JARFILE
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($jar)) { $jar = 'server.jar' }
Write-Output ('Downloading server jar to ' + $jar)
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $jar
Set-Content -Path 'eula.txt' -Value 'eula=true' -Encoding ascii
Write-Output 'Install complete.'

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run the server with.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The version of Minecraft to download and run. Use 'latest' for the newest release, or pin a specific version like '1.21.4'.
